technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI-9, MACD crossovers) show bullish bias, but price remains below intermediate moving averages with weak trend strength (ADX 17.18) and negative volume flow, limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: AIG shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 19 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (20/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 small purchase vs 2 sales 85+ days ago) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (335.68), rising dollar, imminent CPI event, and earnings in 19 days creates extreme risk environment for financial sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9 bullish, MACD crossover up, and Supertrend bullish with extreme fear sentiment (20/100) create short-term momentum setup near support (44.80), offering contrarian entry for tactical swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 335.68, rising DXY), price below all intermediate moving averages, weak trend strength (ADX 17.18), negative volume flow, imminent earnings in 19 days, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction make this a high-risk financial sector trade in deteriorating conditions.
